description: No standalone UJP careers/vacancy page was found on ujp.gov.si or the UJP GOV.SI institution page; UJP postings appear to be routed through the central gov.si vacancy register and are mirrored by aggregators such as Optius.

result.result_summary: Searches in Slovenian for UJP vacancies and director competitions returned the institution profile, Bizi/e-uprava directory entries and an Optius employer page, but no UJP-hosted vacancy list.

why_it_matters: Collection for UJP must be built on institution-filtered queries against gov.si/zbirke/delovna-mesta rather than on a UJP-specific crawler; assuming a dedicated page would silently produce zero events.

description: It could not be established that ATVP or AZN publish individual fit-and-proper decisions (odločbe о dovoljenju za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave) at person level, the way Banka Slovenije clearly does in its issued-authorisations table.

result.result_summary: Slovenian-language searches surfaced ATVP application forms (VPR questionnaires for BPD/DZU board members) and AZN suitability-assessment guidance, plus firm-level registers, but no person-level decision list for either agency.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move coverage on the capital-markets and insurance sides may be structurally thinner than on the banking side; the pipeline should not assume parity across the three supervisors and should plan an AJPES/company-disclosure fallback or an ZDIJZ request.

description: No published person-level ECB/SSM fit-and-proper decision list for Slovenian significant institutions was found.

result.result_summary: English-language searching returned only the SSM Guide to fit and proper assessments, significance-assessment reports and O-SII notifications; confirmed that F&P decisions for significant institutions are legally ECB decisions, but with no individual-decision publication surfaced.

why_it_matters: Board changes at Slovenia's largest banks (the ECB-supervised ones, e.g. NLB) will not appear in the Banka Slovenije authorisations table, creating a blind spot exactly where the market impact is greatest.

description: No RSS/Atom or API feed was identified for the vacancy pages of Banka Slovenije, ATVP or AZN.

result.result_summary: The AZN vacancy page was fetched directly and offers only an HTML list with per-post PDFs plus a 'Novičnik' newsletter; the BS careers hub shows no feed; ATVP publishes vacancies as ordinary news items.

why_it_matters: Collection must be polling-and-diff based with PDF extraction, which raises maintenance cost and means posting-removal (after a deadline) can destroy the record unless snapshots are stored.

description: The ATVP vacancy URL contains an opaque generated path segment (/ID6lNM3Jl6T4gfNt/prosta-delovna-mesta) and ATVP content is served from two hostnames (a-tvp.si and atvp.si).

result.result_summary: Observed in search results; not fetched by me, so liveness is unverified. A future 404 on this path would be a hypothesis of relocation, not evidence the page is gone.

why_it_matters: Hardcoding this URL is fragile; the collector should resolve the vacancy page from the site menu each run and treat both hostnames as one source.

description: https://www.bsi.si/razpisi/kadrovski-razpisi was cited inside Banka Slovenije job adverts as the canonical application address but was not itself fetched in this pass; the BS careers hub did not expose an explicit link to it.

result.result_summary: Path known only from advert text and search snippets.

why_it_matters: It is the likely primary vacancy endpoint for the central bank; it must be resolved by the deterministic liveness pass before being wired into collection, with apl.bsi.si/zaposlitev.asp as the confirmed fallback.

description: No dedicated press-release or announcements index was located for Primorska hranilnica Vipava d.d. despite Slovenian-language searching; only generic corporate pages (phv.si, zgodovina) surfaced, with leadership data appearing mainly on third-party aggregators (LinkedIn, RocketReach, bizi.si).

result.result_summary: Corporate site exists; no governance/news feed identified.

why_it_matters: Leadership and org changes at this savings bank will likely have to be detected via the court/business register or the Bank of Slovenia register rather than a corporate newsroom.

description: Searches in this cell did not surface a live standalone corporate channel for the Sberbank Slovenia successor (N Banka), which was absorbed into NLB; no dedicated newsroom was found for it.

result.result_summary: No standalone N Banka newsroom identified in this pass.

why_it_matters: Historic org-change evidence for that entity must be recovered from NLB disclosures, Bank of Slovenia notices and archives rather than a live corporate site.

description: Seed queries treat Nova KBM and SKB as separate corporate channels, but they were legally merged into OTP banka d.d. with a single Ljubljana-based entity; separate nkbm.si / skb.si newsrooms are therefore likely legacy or redirected.

result.result_summary: Only the merged OTP banka channel was confirmed in search results.

why_it_matters: Collection configs must not assume two live newsrooms; historical archives may still hold pre-merger announcements.

description: This pass focused on governance announcements; no bank career/vacancy portals (e.g. 'kariera', 'zaposlitev', 'prosta delovna mesta' sections) were confirmed for any of the cell's actors.

result.result_summary: Hiring-side sources not yet enumerated for this cell.

why_it_matters: The run's topic list includes jobs and hiring; corporate career pages are the natural first-party source and are currently uncovered.

description: No Slovenia-specific country-manager appointment announcement was found for NCR Atleos or Diebold Nixdorf, in either English or Slovenian search. Results returned only global-level leadership and M&A coverage.

result.result_summary: Searched 'NCR Atleos Diebold Nixdorf Slovenia country manager appointed banking'; all hits were global trade press (American Banker, ATM Marketplace) or the NCR Atleos board page. No SI-country announcement surfaced.

why_it_matters: The global ATM OEMs appear to run Slovenia through regional/distributor structures rather than a locally announced country manager, so leadership signal for them must come from LinkedIn, the SI business register (branch/subsidiary representatives) and partner/distributor announcements — not from vendor newsrooms.

description: No Printec Slovenia local careers page or SI-specific job listing was located this run; only registry/company-profile records for PRINTEC S.I. d.o.o. surfaced.

result.result_summary: Slovenian-language query 'Printec Slovenija zaposlitev prosta delovna mesta' returned generic SI job portals and a CompanyWall entity profile (Vodovodna cesta 100, Ljubljana, ~26 employees, sln_info@printecgroup.com), not a Printec SI careers page.

why_it_matters: For the anchor vendor of this cell, hiring visibility likely depends on the group-level careers site, LinkedIn and the ESS statutory vacancy channel rather than a local careers page — collection design must not assume a local page exists.

description: Marand and 'Result' could not be confirmed this run as currently active Slovenian banking-IT suppliers with public hiring channels; searches naming them returned no Marand/Result pages.

result.result_summary: Query 'Comtrade Marand Halcom zaposlitev razvijalec bancne resitve Ljubljana' and 'Bankart Better Marand ...' returned Comtrade, Halcom and Bankart material only; no Marand or Result result appeared.

why_it_matters: The seeded actor map may contain stale or health-sector-skewed names (Marand's better-known line is health IT / the Better spin-off). The actor map needs verification against AJPES before collection resources are spent on them.

description: There is no established Slovenian-language term for 'delivery centre' in the nearshore-outsourcing sense; searches had to use the English phrase.

result.result_summary: Slovenian equivalents ('razvojni center', 'razvojno sredisce') are generic R&D terms and did not isolate nearshore delivery-centre announcements; the English-in-Slovenian usage 'delivery center' is what vendors actually publish.

why_it_matters: Query design for delivery-centre expansion must mix English-in-local usage with 'razvojni center' + city names, or the signal will be missed entirely in sl-language monitoring.

description: The two highest-yield channels for leadership moves in this cell — LinkedIn and Finance.si — are both restricted (login wall + ToS; paywall).

result.result_summary: LinkedIn company pages appear in results but require authentication and prohibit scraping; Finance.si operates a subscription paywall on its IKT coverage.

why_it_matters: Budget and process must account for licensed/manual collection on these two, otherwise the 'leadership moves' topic will be systematically under-covered for private suppliers.

description: The referenced method playbook path is a Windows path (C:/Users/User/Dropbox/...) and is not present on this macOS machine, so the full routine prompt could not be read.

result.result_summary: Path not accessible from this environment; the run followed the inline METHOD summary instead.

why_it_matters: Any playbook-specific field conventions or classification rules beyond the inline summary were not applied.

description: No Slovenia-specific press room or country-newsroom was found for Nexi Group. Slovenian operations appear to be managed jointly with Croatia at management-board level, and searches for a Slovenia country-manager announcement returned only the analogous Switzerland appointment plus group-level CFO news.

result.result_summary: Group PR archive and governance PDFs exist and are collectable, but Slovenia-scoped payments leadership news is sparse to absent in them.

why_it_matters: Payments-side (non-bank) leadership changes in SI may be invisible in group PR entirely and require registry- or media-based detection instead.

description: Searches in German for a Steiermaerkische Sparkasse press channel carrying Slovenian subsidiary board appointments returned only corporate/board pages, no press-release stream containing SI appointment items.

result.result_summary: Parent discloses its own Vorstand and the Sparkassenrat appointment mechanism, but SI subsidiary appointments appear to be announced by Banka Sparkasse d.d. in Slovenian instead.

why_it_matters: Confirms an inverted assumption for this ownership chain: for Steiermaerkische the local Slovenian site is primary, not the HQ - so HQ-only monitoring would miss everything here.

description: Raiffeisen was named in the cell scope, but no evidence surfaced in these searches of a current Raiffeisen banking subsidiary in Slovenia issuing leadership announcements; Raiffeisen Banka d.d. exited the Slovenian market years ago.

result.result_summary: No live Raiffeisen SI subsidiary press channel identified in this pass.

why_it_matters: Avoids wasting collector budget on a defunct actor; any residual RBI SI entity (leasing, representative office) needs a separate targeted check before being added.

description: Societe Generale legacy in Slovenia (SKB banka) no longer exists as a separate announcing entity: SKB was acquired by OTP and legally merged with Nova KBM into OTP banka d.d.

result.result_summary: SKB-branded press channels are historical only; announcements now flow through OTP banka d.d. and OTP Group.

why_it_matters: Historical archives remain valuable for people-tracking (e.g. Anita Stojcevska's path from SKB to the OTP board) but must not be polled as a live source.

description: UniCredit Leasing Slovenija: no dedicated SI leasing press channel or 2025 appointment announcement was located; the leasing leadership signal appears at regional level (a regional manager covering Croatia/Slovenia/Serbia/BiH) and is reported through Croatian outlets.

result.result_summary: Slovenian leasing leadership is disclosed regionally or via registry data, not via a SI press room.

why_it_matters: Non-bank credit subsidiaries are a structural blind spot; registry monitoring is the only reliable route for them.

description: Vienna Insurance Group's press centre yielded group and Austrian managing-board changes but no Slovenia-scoped bancassurance appointment; VIG's SI presence is described as a branch of the Austrian Wiener Staedtische entity.

result.result_summary: Branch structure means no separate SI management board is disclosed at all.

why_it_matters: For branch-form actors, 'leadership move' evidence must come from branch-manager registry entries or media, not group PR.

description: No liveness verification was performed on any URL in this slice. Two entries carry inferred paths: the Intesa Sanpaolo SI 'aktualne objave' listing (inferred upward from an observed article URL) and the Sparkasse.si /sl/novice index (inferred from date-partitioned article URLs).

result.result_summary: Both should be treated as high-probability but unconfirmed until the deterministic verification pass runs.

why_it_matters: Prevents a downstream reader from treating an inferred listing path as a confirmed endpoint.

description: Searching in Slovenian for SEOnet announcements specifically about bank management-board changes ('objava sprememba uprave banke') returned only generic descriptions of the SEOnet system and unrelated portal pages, not a retrievable list of board-change filings.

result.result_summary: SEOnet clearly exists and archives issuer notices by ?doc_id=, but its announcement corpus is not well indexed by general web search; two individual doc_id permalinks surfaced, no searchable topical listing did.

why_it_matters: SEOnet must be harvested by crawling its own issuer/date filters rather than via search engines; a search-engine-only strategy would miss most board-change filings.

description: No dedicated investor/annual-report landing page was surfaced for several smaller Slovenian deposit-takers - Delavska hranilnica, Addiko Bank Slovenija, Banka Sparkasse, Dezelna banka Slovenije, Hranilnica LON, Primorska hranilnica Vipava, BKS Bank AG branch - despite explicit local-language searching naming them.

result.result_summary: Searches named these institutions but returned aggregator and news pages rather than their own statutory-disclosure pages.

why_it_matters: These institutions still file with AJPES, so the archival record exists; it just has to be reached through JOLP rather than their own sites. Recording them as absent from the source map would be wrong.

description: The Slovenian phrase 'izjava o upravljanju druzbe' (corporate governance statement) did not by itself surface standalone governance-statement documents for SI banks in this run; such statements appear to be embedded as chapters inside the annual report PDFs rather than published as separate files.

result.result_summary: No separate governance-statement document located for any SI bank.

why_it_matters: Collection design must parse governance statements out of the annual report PDF rather than expecting a discrete document per bank.

description: No source in this cell was fetched or verified for liveness; all URLs come from search-result metadata and content excerpts. Some deep PDF links are year-specific and will change (e.g. the Intesa Sanpaolo path embeds both a publication year and a report year).

result.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores, not verification claims.

why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must treat deep PDF links as volatile and prefer the listing-page URL as the durable entry point.

description: No standing, publicly indexed 'Bančnik leta' / banker-of-the-year individual award for Slovenia was found. The award signals that do exist are institutional (The Banker 'Banka leta v Sloveniji', Euromoney awards of excellence) and are republished by the winning banks rather than by a Slovenian awarding body.

result.result_summary: Searches in sl for nagrada/priznanje + bančništvo returned only bank-hosted awards pages (OTP banka) and generic ECB/ESRB pages; no Slovenian individual banking-leadership award body surfaced.

why_it_matters: Individual awards would be a high-quality named-person signal for leadership moves; without one, the cell must rely on speaker rosters and institutional award pages for person-level data.

description: No Slovenian national fintech association with a public member/speaker directory was identified. Searches for 'Fintech Slovenija združenje' returned events (FinTech Day, Finančna konferenca) and ZBS press releases, but no standalone association body.

result.result_summary: Fintech representation in Slovenia appears to run through ZBS, the startup ecosystem (startup.si, DIH Slovenia) and the regional Money Motion event rather than a national fintech association.

why_it_matters: Removes an expected pointer source; collection must instead aggregate across ecosystem calendars, which is noisier and needs broader keyword sweeps.

description: No public, machine-readable list of IEDC Bled corporate/bank partners or of banks sponsoring Executive MBA seats was found.

result.result_summary: English searches returned only third-party MBA directories (mastersportal, find-mba, best-masters) and Wikipedia; no partner or client list on an IEDC-controlled page was surfaced. Slovenian-language terms for this ('partnerji', 'korporativni programi') were not productive either.

why_it_matters: The executive-pipeline signal for IEDC is therefore weaker than hypothesised in the cell rationale and should be de-prioritised relative to faculty scholarship calls, which are concrete and quantified.

description: The seed query used 'Dnevi slovenskih bankirjev'; the actual ZBS event naming appears to be 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov' (singular day, 'bančnik' not 'bankir') alongside the generic 'Bančna konferenca'. The seed term is a near-miss that would under-retrieve.

result.result_summary: Correct local terms confirmed from the ZBS site: 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov', 'Bančna konferenca', 'terminski plan', 'strokovna izobraževanja'.

why_it_matters: Glossary correction; downstream collection queries should use 'bančnik/bančniki' and both singular and plural event forms to avoid missing the flagship roster.

description: The ISACA Slovenia Chapter events list is hosted on the engage.isaca.org community platform, which mixes public and member-gated pages.

result.result_summary: Individual event-description URLs are publicly indexed, but the main 'seznam dogodkov' page was reported as carrying administrative restrictions. Not confirmed by direct fetch — recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: Collection design should target the public event-description URL pattern rather than the list page, and must not attempt to access member-only areas.

description: The SBS homepage was fetched directly. Its navigation is limited to Sindikat, Članstvo, Zaposleni, Kontakt and Dokumenti; no 'Novice' section and no RSS feed were visible on the page.

result.result_summary: The single most important union in this cell has no observable news channel, so its positions reach the public mainly through media (Delo, Megafon) rather than through its own site.

why_it_matters: Collection design cannot rely on an SBS feed; it must combine document-listing diffing with media keyword monitoring, otherwise union statements will be missed entirely.

description: Searched in Slovenian for Sindikat NLB. Only a business-registry entry and media mentions were returned; no own website or press page was found in the results reviewed.

result.result_summary: Company-level bank unions in Slovenia appear largely to lack independent web presence.

why_it_matters: House unions are decisive actors (Sindikat NLB signed the 2026 tariff annex that SBS rejected) yet are only observable second-hand, which weakens attribution and timing precision.

description: Searched in Slovenian for the employer duty to notify ZRSZ of collective dismissals. The obligation and its 30-day deadline are well documented, but no public register or dataset of individual notifications was found.

result.result_summary: The earliest official signal of a bank restructuring exists as an administrative filing that is not published.

why_it_matters: The highest-value leading indicator in this cell is not directly collectable; it must be approached via aggregate ZRSZ statistics or an information-access request, which introduces lag.

description: Searched in Slovenian combining works councils with banks. ZSDS/ŠCID was identified as the association, but no bank-specific works-council material surfaced in the results reviewed.

result.result_summary: Works councils exist as an institution with a national association, but bank-level council activity is not visible on the open web.

why_it_matters: Works councils have statutory information/consultation rights over mergers and headcount decisions, so their invisibility removes a channel that should in principle pre-date public announcements.

description: English-language search for 2026 Slovenian bank branch closures and union statements returned only older material (a 2020 programme of roughly 300 job cuts, a Slovak factoring unit closure of 307 jobs) and general group pages.

result.result_summary: English-only searching does not reach current Slovenian workforce news; the Slovenian-language searches returned materially different and more current results.

why_it_matters: Confirms empirically that this cell cannot be run in English; monolingual English collection would have produced a false picture of quiescence.

description: Searched UNI Europa for the Slovenian affiliate by its acronym SBS. The federation's material on CEE bargaining (BARSERVICE project) was found, but no page naming a Slovenian banking affiliate appeared in the results reviewed.

result.result_summary: The Slovenian banking union's European affiliation could not be confirmed from the results obtained; 'SBS' is also a noisy acronym.

why_it_matters: Without confirmed affiliation, the European federation cannot be relied on as a proxy feed for Slovenian union positions.

description: No 'PaymentsDossier'-style dedicated Slovenian or Adriatic payments people-move column was found. The only true dedicated regional people-moves column located is CEE Legal Matters' 'On The Move' / 'In-House Moves', which is legal/compliance-skewed rather than payments-skewed.

result.result_summary: Searches across Finextra, The Paypers, FinTech Futures, IBS Intelligence and PYMNTS returned no Slovenia-specific appointment column or country people-move feed.

why_it_matters: A5 cannot rely on a single English people-move column for SI; coverage must be assembled from SeeNews + STA English + parent-group newsrooms.

description: Finextra returned zero Slovenia-specific people-move results across two query formulations; results degraded into consumer 'how to open a bank account in Slovenia' content.

result.result_summary: Search 'Finextra Slovenia bank appointment people moves' produced no Finextra SI article.

why_it_matters: Finextra should be kept only as a low-frequency broad-net alert, not a primary A5 channel for Slovenia.

description: total-slovenia-news.com returned HTTP 525 and fintechfutures.com returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch.

result.result_summary: Two of the cell's named seed sources could not be retrieved in this pass.

why_it_matters: These are hypotheses, not verdicts: 403 indicates bot defence on a live site, 525 indicates a CDN/origin TLS problem. Both need retry with browser headers and a Wayback cross-check before any liveness verdict.

description: Slovenian-language queries (e.g. 'slovenska banka imenovanje uprave predsednik uprave NLB') returned only domestic outlets (Reporter, Delo, nlb.si, nlbskladi.si) and no Slovenian-language aggregator that translates INTO English.

result.result_summary: The sl-language search surface for this cell resolves to local media, which belong to other coverage cells; the only bilingual bridges found are issuer English mirrors (nlbgroup.com/int-en, otpbanka.si English, group.intesasanpaolo.com/en).

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's translation channel is one-directional: English aggregators pull from Slovenian originals, so sl-language monitoring must stay in the local-media cell while this cell watches the English re-publication layer.

description: No dedicated Croatian/Adriatic English-language banking trade outlet covering Slovenian appointments was identified beyond SeeNews and bne IntelliNews.

result.result_summary: The 'Adriatic trade press' hypothesis did not resolve to a distinct publisher; SEE-wide coverage concentrates in SeeNews and IntelliNews.

why_it_matters: Avoids wasted collector build effort on a channel that does not exist as a distinct source.

description: Banka Slovenije vacancy application (apl.bsi.si/zaposlitev.asp) returned 'Trenutno ni razpisanih mest' — no open positions at time of scouting.

result.result_summary: Source is live and correctly structured, but currently carries zero vacancies. This is a real observation, not a failure.

why_it_matters: The collector must distinguish 'no vacancies' from 'fetch failed'; the Slovenian empty-state string should be encoded as a recognised sentinel so the central bank is not silently dropped.

description: https://otpbanka.fledgehr.com/jobs (OTP banka's actual vacancy board) could not be retrieved: 'Too many redirects (exceeded 10)'.

result.result_summary: Almost certainly a cookie/JS-gated single-page app rather than a dead endpoint — the URL is linked directly from otpbanka.si/kariera.

why_it_matters: OTP banka is the #2 SI bank; losing its vacancy feed would be a major coverage hole. Needs a headless-browser or API-level collector, not plain HTTP.

description: https://zaposlitve.unicreditbank.si/ rendered only a logo, a GDPR document link and a footer; the 'Prosta delovna mesta' heading was present but no job records.

result.result_summary: Client-side rendered portal; ATS vendor could not be identified from the served HTML.

why_it_matters: UniCredit Banka Slovenija's hiring is currently unobservable by simple fetch; the ATS vendor is also unidentified, which is itself a gap in the HR-tech map.

description: https://www.nlb.si/zaposlitev returned HTTP 404, and https://www.skb.si/sl/o-skb/zaposlitev 302-redirects to https://www.otpbanka.si/sl/o-skb/zaposlitev.

result.result_summary: Careers content for NLB now lives under nlbgroup.com/int-en/careers/...; SKB banka's careers content has been absorbed into otpbanka.si following the SKB/Nova KBM–OTP consolidation.

why_it_matters: Any pre-existing source list pointing at nlb.si/zaposlitev or skb.si careers is stale. The SKB redirect is itself corroborating evidence of the completed merger and of org consolidation — record it as a signal, not just a broken link.

description: Delavska hranilnica, Dezelna banka Slovenije, Gorenjska banka and Hranilnica LON publish vacancies as plain CMS pages with email-only application (kadrovska@dh.si, kadri@lon.si) — no ATS layer at all.

result.result_summary: A material share of the SI banking sector has no Workday/SmartRecruiters/Talentlyft footprint; the cell's ATS-platform hypothesis holds only for foreign-owned groups (Cornerstone at NLB, SuccessFactors at Intesa, Erste portal at Sparkasse, FledgeHR at OTP).

why_it_matters: Collection design cannot assume structured ATS feeds; roughly half the actors need bespoke HTML diffing, and Workday/SmartRecruiters/Talentlyft were NOT observed at any Slovenian bank in this pass.

description: Addiko Bank Slovenija's /prosta-delovna-mesta/ page returned culture, process and benefits content but no enumerable job rows.

result.result_summary: Either the list is JS-injected or the bank had no open roles at that moment; cannot distinguish from a single fetch.

why_it_matters: Addiko is an M&A target (NLB bid) — its hiring trajectory is high-value context. Must be re-checked with a rendering fetcher before concluding anything.

description: The seed-style query term 'banka Slovenija' collides with the central bank 'Banka Slovenije' and with generic 'bank in Slovenia'; 'LON' collides with placenames and the English word; 'kariera' returns employer-branding pages rather than vacancy lists.

result.result_summary: Query design must use exact institution legal names ('Delavska hranilnica d.d.', 'Hranilnica LON d.d., Kranj', 'Dezelna banka Slovenije d.d.') and vacancy-specific terms ('prosta delovna mesta', 'aktualna delovna mesta', 'razpisana mesta', 'zaposlujemo') rather than 'kariera'.

why_it_matters: Prevents both false positives and missed vacancy pages in the recurring collection queries.

description: No Slovenian-language equivalent or local vocabulary was found for the ATS product names themselves (Workday, SmartRecruiters, Talentlyft, Cornerstone, FledgeHR) — Slovenian bank career pages use the English product/vendor names or expose no vendor name at all.

result.result_summary: ATS identification in SI must be done by URL/domain fingerprinting, not by local-language search.

why_it_matters: Local-language search cannot map the HR-tech stack here; the collector needs a domain-fingerprint rule set instead.

description: No Slovenian-language news source dedicated to payments-sector leadership appointments was surfaced. A targeted sl query using 'imenovanje', 'nov direktor', 'plačilne institucije' returned only an executive-search marketing page, EU/ECB institutional pages and unrelated ministry appointments.

result.result_summary: Finance.si and similar business media were not reachable through search results in this pass; their paywalled archives were not confirmed.

why_it_matters: Leadership moves at non-bank payment employers may only be discoverable via LinkedIn (ToS-blocked) and AJPES court-register publications, leaving a media-confirmation gap.

description: 'Settle' in the cell brief maps to Settle Group, identified in results as a Norwegian VC-backed fintech, not a Slovenian entity. No Slovenian Settle payments employer was confirmed, and no Slovenian careers surface was found for 'Trustee' either.

result.result_summary: Two named seed actors could not be tied to a verified Slovenian employer presence in this pass.

why_it_matters: The cell's actor map needs correction before crawlers are pointed at non-existent or foreign entities; the Settle/Halcom pairing in the brief may be a conflation.

description: No dedicated careers/zaposlitev page was located for Paywiser, Eligma/GoCrypto, or Trustee despite a combined sl-language query. Only a Facebook page, a startup.si profile, LinkedIn personal profiles and press coverage surfaced.

result.result_summary: Smaller Slovenian PSP/EMI actors appear to hire without a persistent public careers URL.

why_it_matters: Hiring at the smaller, faster-moving end of the payments landscape will be invisible to a careers-page-only crawler and must be caught via aggregators, AJPES and manual LinkedIn review.

description: 'Nexi Slovenia' appears under several legal/brand lineages (ex-Plačilni sistemi d.o.o., Mercury Processing Services International, Nexi Croatia/nexi.hr company-data pages, Nexi Central Europe a.s.). No single canonical Slovenian legal entity name and registration number was established in this pass.

result.result_summary: Brand-to-legal-entity mapping for the largest processor group in the cell is unresolved.

why_it_matters: Without the canonical entity name/matična številka, AJPES and eObjave monitoring for leadership and org changes cannot be reliably targeted.

description: LinkedIn and Glassdoor — the two richest surfaces for leadership moves and reorganizations at these non-bank employers — are both auth/registration-walled and prohibit automated collection in their terms.

result.result_summary: Highest-signal sources are legally unavailable for automated collection.

why_it_matters: Workstream A5 will depend on manual analyst review or a licensed data provider for its single best leadership-move signal.

description: No public API or bulk-download endpoint for the AJPES ePRS representative (zastopnik) data was identified through search. The ePRS web interface appears to be the only confirmed public access path, and AJPES separately documents per-user daily query caps on related services.

result.result_summary: ePRS confirmed as a web search interface; no API documentation surfaced in sl or en queries.

why_it_matters: Systematic monitoring of every SI banking/payments entity's representatives may require either the OPSI bulk dataset (field coverage unconfirmed) or a commercial data licence from AJPES; this affects collection design and cost.

description: Searches surfaced an AJPES notice that access to public court-register data changed following the ZSReg-E amendment, including suppression of EMSO and of personal data not directly connected to the role, and a ~1-year retention window for some published decisions. The exact current access rules for automated retrieval were not established.

result.result_summary: Access change confirmed to exist; precise post-ZSReg-E rules not determined.

why_it_matters: Leadership-change detection depends on personal names remaining published. If suppression is broader than assumed, the court-register route degrades and the run must lean more on regulator registers and corporate announcements. Also implies eObjave must be archived locally before items age out.

description: The Banka Slovenije supervised-entities hub page lists sub-registers (credit intermediaries, real-estate financial lease providers, credit servicers, list of companies requiring BS consent for insolvency proceedings) but the individual deep URLs for each were observed only as on-page links and were not separately resolved. They are recorded against the hub URL rather than invented.

result.result_summary: Sub-registers confirmed to exist; individual URLs not captured.

why_it_matters: A follow-up crawl of the hub is needed to produce directly addressable, monitorable URLs for each sub-register.

description: Searching in Slovenian for a standalone register of account information service providers returned only the general supervised-entities register and the non-bank PSP oversight hub - no dedicated AISP register page was identified on bsi.si.

result.result_summary: AISPs appear to be carried inside the consolidated Register subjektov nadzora and in the EBA PIR rather than in a separate SI list.

why_it_matters: AISP monitoring should be driven off the EBA PIR (country=SI) plus the consolidated BS register, not off a presumed dedicated national page.

description: Queries for Slovenian commercial company-data aggregators (bizi.si, gvin.com) that resell register data with director histories did not return substantive confirmation of those services or their coverage of representative-change history.

result.result_summary: No verified commercial aggregator source captured for this cell.

why_it_matters: Commercial aggregators are usually the only practical way to get historical representative-change time series rather than current-state snapshots; this remains an unexplored acquisition option.

description: MojeDelo.com - the portal the cell brief names as central and which secondary sources call the largest SI employment portal - could not be retrieved by the fetch tool ('Claude Code is unable to fetch from www.mojedelo.com'). No category URL scheme, RSS presence or ad volume could be confirmed first-hand.

result.result_summary: Site treated as bot-defended-but-live; no structural facts recorded. Its banking/IT category paths were NOT guessed and must be confirmed in a browser.

why_it_matters: The single highest-value source in this cell is currently undocumented at the structural level, so any collection plan built now would be based on assumption rather than observation.

description: https://www.zaposlitev.net/ failed DNS resolution (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). Secondary sources describe it as the first SI employment portal, but no live page was reached and no 2025/2026 evidence of activity was found in search.

result.result_summary: Status unresolved - possibly retired, parked, or blocked from this network. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: A named seed source may no longer exist; if confirmed retired, the cell's coverage assumption must shift entirely to Optius, MojeDelo and Zaposlitev.info.

description: The state vacancy register is operationally behind PoiščiDelo.si, which explicitly restricts use to registered users (email/password or digital certificate). No public search interface, RSS or documented API was found for individual ESS vacancy records.

result.result_summary: The most complete national vacancy dataset is not openly collectable; only the rules pages and aggregate labour-market content are public.

why_it_matters: Undermines the cell's core rationale that the legally mandated state notice board yields a full employer census - the census exists but is not openly readable, forcing reliance on EURES relay or manual account review.

description: A hypothesised banking/finance category on BorzaDela.si (borzadela.si/podrocja/bancnistvo-finance-zavarovalnistvo) was fetched and returned only student/temporary work in warehousing, manufacturing and hospitality; no banking or finance employers appeared among the results shown.

result.result_summary: No usable banking vertical on that marketplace; only a generic IT category (podrocja/racunalnistvo-programiranje-it) is confirmed.

why_it_matters: Prevents a false-positive source entry and saves crawl budget; confirms student-work marketplaces are peripheral for this sector.

description: No dedicated Slovenian job board specialising in banking, payments, cards or ATM roles was found in either sl or en searches - no equivalent of a sector-only vacancy site. Coverage is entirely via sector CATEGORIES on general boards plus general IT boards.

result.result_summary: Sector-specialist board: does not appear to exist for SI.

why_it_matters: Confirms that category filters on general boards, not a niche portal, are the correct collection design for this market's small size.

description: Highly specific local payment-domain queries ('kartično poslovanje', 'bančni informacijski sistemi', 'plačilni promet', 'bankomat') returned almost no board-level hits through the search engine; matching ads were only visible after landing on the boards' own category pages.

result.result_summary: Search engines do not index SI vacancy long-tail well; the terms are valid but must be applied as on-site filters rather than as web queries.

why_it_matters: Dictates collection architecture: crawl-then-filter on the boards, rather than search-engine-driven discovery of individual ads.

description: No 'MojeDelo IT' sub-brand or separate IT vertical for MojeDelo could be confirmed, and no evidence was found that Zaposlitev.net belongs to the Styria network (Styria ownership was confirmed only for MojeDelo, via Styria digital marketplaces d.o.o., acquired 2013).

result.result_summary: Two assumptions embedded in the cell brief remain unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: Avoids building a syndication/dedup model on an unverified ownership graph.

description: Job boards proved to be weak sources for leadership moves specifically: no board surface was found that publishes executive appointments, and no SI executive-search firm vacancy page (e.g. Competo) was directly confirmed in this pass beyond a mention in an aggregated company list.

result.result_summary: Leadership-move coverage from this cell is indirect at best (recruiter mandates for senior roles).

why_it_matters: The 'leadership moves' topic in the run scope will need coverage from other cells (press releases, registry filings, trade press), not from job boards.

description: No Slovenian Indeed domain (si.indeed.com / indeed.si) surfaced in search; results resolved to indeed.com generic 'Slovenia' keyword queries with mostly irrelevant global postings.

result.result_summary: Indeed appears to have no dedicated SI property; keyword-based indeed.com queries return very noisy results and are not a reliable SI banking hiring feed.

why_it_matters: The brief assumed 'Indeed SI' exists; collection design should rely on Optius/MojeDelo/Careerjet.si instead and treat Indeed as optional low-yield.

description: Glassdoor results for 'NLB' are dominated by NLB Services (an unrelated Indian IT staffing firm, ~850 reviews) and NLB Corp, not NLB Group (Ljubljana, employer id E553398).

result.result_summary: Only the E553398 profile is the Slovenian bank; all other NLB profiles are false positives.

why_it_matters: Any automated employer-review collection keyed on the string 'NLB' will ingest wrong-company data and corrupt sentiment/headcount inferences.

description: Searches in Slovenian for search-firm placement announcements ('imenovanje', 'izvršno iskanje kadrov') returned firm marketing pages but no named placement-announcement pages for SI banking roles.

result.result_summary: SI-domiciled search firms (Competo, Trescon, Amrop Adria, Kadring) appear to publish service descriptions rather than named client placements; only international networks (Pedersen & Partners, Boyden) reliably publish named placement news.

why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed recruiters publicise placements; in SI that mainly holds for the international networks, so collection weight should shift there plus LinkedIn individual posts.

description: Kadring's own website was never returned in results; its URL was inferred from the firm name and is not confirmed.

result.result_summary: Kadring is corroborated as a real SI recruitment agency by secondary directories, but no first-party page was observed.

why_it_matters: The candidate entry must be liveness-verified before being trusted; do not treat the inferred URL as confirmed.

description: The core channel of this cell - LinkedIn individual 'new role' posts - is not reachable anonymously and cannot be enumerated by search.

result.result_summary: Only company-page shells surfaced via si.linkedin.com; individual post-level content was not observable in this run.

why_it_matters: The earliest leadership-move signal in this cell is structurally hard to automate; budget for analyst monitoring or a licensed data source.

description: Direct fetch of https://www.finance.si/ was refused by the fetch tool, so the site's section taxonomy (banking vertical, any dedicated 'kadri'/'kadrovske spremembe' column) and RSS endpoints could not be enumerated.

result.result_summary: No section map obtained; site presumed live but bot-defended and paywalled. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: Finance is the single most likely outlet to break Slovenian bank leadership moves; without a mapped section/RSS path, collection design for the highest-value source in this cell is incomplete.

description: Searched in Slovenian for a standing 'kadrovske spremembe' / 'imenovanja' appointments column at Finance.si and at STA. No dedicated, named rubric surfaced in search results for either outlet.

result.result_summary: Personnel items appear scattered across general business sections (Delo /gospodarstvo/kariera, Siol /posel-danes) rather than in a single named appointments column at the two outlets where the cell brief assumed one exists.

why_it_matters: Collection cannot rely on one tidy column feed per outlet; keyword-driven filtering across whole business sections is required, which raises noise and cost.

description: The Slovenian terms 'kadrovske spremembe', 'kadrovske menjave' and 'imenovanja' are dominated by government/public-sector reshuffle coverage (ministries, police, state agencies) rather than banking.

result.result_summary: Multiple searches returned mostly government appointment stories; banking hits required pairing with 'banka', 'uprava banke', 'bančnik' or a named institution.

why_it_matters: Any keyword monitor must AND the personnel term with a bank/actor term, or precision will collapse.

description: Section URLs for Dnevnik (/posel), Večer (/gospodarstvo), RTV SLO (/gospodarstvo) and STA English (english.sta.si) were inferred from article patterns and general knowledge, not confirmed by a successful fetch in this run.

result.result_summary: Domains are well evidenced; the exact section paths are hypotheses to be resolved by the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Crawler configuration built on unconfirmed paths would silently collect nothing.

description: Searched for investigative outlet Necenzurirano covering banking personnel changes; no relevant banking-personnel items surfaced in the results returned.

result.result_summary: Outlet not evidenced for this cell in this run; not listed as a candidate to avoid asserting unverified coverage.

why_it_matters: Investigative outlets often reveal contested appointments; the gap should be retested with targeted Slovenian queries.

description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech trade association could be located. Searches in both sl and en for 'Združenje FinTech Slovenija', 'Slovenian Fintech Association', 'Zavod Fintech' and 'fintech združenje članstvo' returned no such organisation — only a same-named private company (FINTECH d.o.o.), the Slovak FinTech association, and unrelated bodies.

result.result_summary: Slovenia appears to lack a standalone fintech association; the nearest functional substitutes are Blockchain Alliance Europe, the Slovenian Digital Coalition blockchain working group, and GZS ZIT.

why_it_matters: The cell's seed assumption of a 'Slovenian Fintech association' as a leadership/member index does not hold; fintech leadership signals must be reconstructed from adjacent bodies and from startup-ecosystem channels instead.

description: No GZS branch association or section specifically for financial services / fintech was found. GZS's 26 branch associations include ZIT (ICT) but searches for 'sekcija za finančne storitve' returned nothing matching.

result.result_summary: Banking is represented in Slovenia by ZBS (a separate GIZ), not by a GZS section — so GZS is a general-economy source in this cell, not a banking one.

why_it_matters: Avoids wasted crawl budget hunting a non-existent GZS finance section, and confirms ZBS as the single sector-specific chamber-equivalent for banking.

description: A direct fetch of the Slovenian-language governance path https://www.zbs-giz.si/o-zbs/ returned HTTP 404. The English equivalent /en/about-zbs/ fetched successfully and carried the full dated board roster.

result.result_summary: Treated as a URL-pattern/hypothesis error, NOT as a dead site — the sl site is very likely live under a different slug that was not discovered in this pass.

why_it_matters: The Slovenian-language pages may be more current or more detailed than the English ones; the correct sl slug should be resolved from the site's own navigation before the collector is configured.

description: The GZS ZIT page /vsebina/Sekcije-Projekti surfaced in search results with an injected spam title in a foreign language (an APK/login spam string), suggesting the page or its index entry has been compromised or defaced.

result.result_summary: Content on that specific GZS subpage is not trustworthy as-fetched.

why_it_matters: Any automated ingest of GZS branch-association subpages needs a content-sanity gate, or the corpus will absorb spam text as if it were chamber content.

description: No association in this cell was found to publish a dedicated careers/zaposlitve page for its own secretariat. Secretariat hiring signals appear only incidentally (LinkedIn posts, register headcount, press releases).

result.result_summary: The 'associations as employers' half of the cell rationale is served only indirectly.

why_it_matters: Secretariat hiring — the agenda-shift signal — must be inferred from EU Transparency Register FTE figures, AJPES filings and LinkedIn rather than from a scrapeable jobs feed.

description: Multiple sources indicate that from 1 March 2026 the razglasni del of Uradni list RS no longer publishes javni razpisi, javni natečaji and similar announcements; such content moved to the proposer's own website, or to the central government website where the proposer has none.

result.result_summary: Historic single-venue crawl of Uradni list is no longer sufficient for 2026+ coverage; publication is now fragmented across institutional sites and gov.si. Not independently verified against the primary legal act in this pass.

why_it_matters: A collector built on Uradni list alone would silently go blind from March 2026 onward for exactly the statutory job notices this cell depends on.

description: No specific live Slovenian public-sector tender for 'card personalisation', 'payment gateway support' or explicit IT staff-augmentation at UJP/FURS was surfaced by search-engine queries in this pass.

result.result_summary: Search engines do not index the enarocanje.si/e-JN notice bodies well; the hypothesis is that such notices exist but are only discoverable through the portals' own search and CPV filters, not via general web search.

why_it_matters: Confirms that the collection method for this cell must be portal-native (CPV/buyer filters, OPSI datasets, TED API) rather than web-search-driven; a web-search-only collector would produce false negatives.

description: The exact URL of the central GOV.SI 'Delovna mesta' vacancy listing with the 'Tip objave = Javni natečaji' filter was described in results but no canonical listing URL was captured.

result.result_summary: Only the descriptive eUprava page and individual institution pages were pinned; the aggregator endpoint remains a hypothesis to resolve by browsing gov.si directly.

why_it_matters: That aggregator would collapse many per-institution crawls into one; leaving it unresolved forces redundant per-body polling.

description: No dedicated public procurement or vacancy publication route was identified in this pass for Bankart d.o.o. (the domestic card processor) or for Bank Assets Management Company successors, despite their central role in Slovenian payments.

result.result_summary: These entities are bank-owned rather than classic budget users, so they may fall outside ZJN-3 publication duties; treated as an open question, not as an absence of activity.

why_it_matters: If a key payments processor is outside the public-publication perimeter, the public-sector route structurally cannot see its hiring or reorganisation, and another workstream must cover it.

description: No confirmation was found of a documented open API or bulk export for ESS (Zavod RS za zaposlovanje) vacancy data.

result.result_summary: Only the human-facing job-search interface was located; bulk access is unverified.

why_it_matters: Determines whether ESS can be a cheap primary feed or only a manual-check secondary source.
